scenarios.prompt: A third-person camera backs into a thin wall while maximum authored recoil and shake are active. Define a collision solve that keeps the final near plane outside the wall.

criteria.frustum: Collision protects the near-plane/frustum footprint rather than only the camera origin.
criteria.offsets: Shake/recoil/shoulder offsets are included in or revalidated by the final collision-safe transform.
criteria.evidence: Wall, corner, FOV/aspect and moving-geometry cases record final safe pose/normal before claiming pass.
